info.title: Holocron dashboard API
info.description: Generated from the operation registry in crates/protocol. Commands need the request marker header and a same-origin Origin, unless sent with an API key.

post.description:
Sets a new password and ends every other session of the caller (R-AUTH). Needs
 reauthentication. 12 to 256 characters.

get.description: The caller's account. Reachable from an enrollment-only session.

post.description:
Changes the caller's name and email. Emails are unique after trimming and lower
 casing; a taken email is `invalid_arguments` on `email`.
Replaces the caller's preferences. Absent fields fall back to the installation default.

get.description:
Computes an exploration state and optional panels (other cuts of the same rows and
 range) in one analytical snapshot. Needs `site.read`. Refusals name the field:
 `invalid_arguments`, `duplicate_predicate_id`, `filter_too_deep`,
 `too_many_conditions`, `page_out_of_range`, `report_missing`.

Every row of an exploration (up to 10,000) as a file, with the state, resolved range
 and versions it was computed from. Needs `site.export`.

What a result over `[start, end)` can claim: the ingestion watermark, whether
 identity days that can change the range still wait for correction, the metric
 version and the session policy versions in effect. Needs `site.read`.

post.description: Adds a note at an instant of the site's charts. Needs `site.definitions.write`.

get.description: Annotations with `start <= at < end`, oldest first. Needs `site.read`.

post.description:
Creates a key and discloses its secret once. Needs reauthentication. Every operation
 must be key-grantable in the registry (`keyGrantableOperations` in the generated
 code) and within the caller's current capabilities on every listed site, else
 `grant_exceeds_principal`. A site the caller cannot see is `not_found`. Unknown
 operation names are `invalid_arguments`. At most 50 active keys per person.

get.description: The caller's keys, newest first, revoked ones included. Never the secret.

post.description:
Revokes one of the caller's keys at once. Requests with it answer like an unknown
 key, and its subscriptions end. Revoking a revoked key answers the key unchanged.

Checks email and password. Wrong password and unknown email answer the same
 `invalid_credentials`. Without 2FA it sets the session cookie and answers
 `signed_in`. An enrolled account answers `second_factor_required` and sets a
 challenge cookie for `auth.verifySecondFactor`; the challenge is never a session. An
 account that must use 2FA but has not enrolled gets an enrollment-only session
 (decision 0007). 10 attempts per client address per minute (`rate_limited`). A
 replayed key returns the stored answer without a new session or challenge.
Ends the current session and clears its cookie.

Checks the password, and the second factor when enrolled, and marks the current
 session for 10 minutes so sensitive commands pass (decision 0007). A wrong password
 is `invalid_credentials`, a missing second factor `second_factor_required`, a wrong
 one `second_factor_invalid`; none of them ends the session. Shares the login limit.
Ends every other session of the caller. The current one stays.

get.description:
The signed-in account, or `null`. Answers signed-out callers and share viewers too,
 never 401. API keys cannot hold it.

post.description:
Finishes a login with a time-based code or an unused recovery code and turns the
 challenge cookie into a session cookie. A wrong or used code is
 `second_factor_invalid`; after 5 wrong codes, or 5 minutes, the challenge ends and
 answers `unauthenticated`.
Creates an empty board. Needs a workspace role above viewer.

get.description: The workspace's boards by name.

post.description: Appends a card holding a complete exploration state of a site in the board's workspace.

Renames a board and replaces its card list: reorder, retitle or remove cards by
 sending the list in the new order. Cards keep their IDs and states. Refused with
 `stale_revision` when `expected_revision` is older than the workspace topic.

get.description:
Collection availability, per-route outcomes, inbox depth and age, and the analytical
 watermark. Install admins only; others get `forbidden`.

post.description:
Creates a collection key for a site and discloses its secret once. Needs
 `site.configure`. A `POST /api/send` or `/api/batch` carrying it as
 `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` is trusted for this site: `payload.ip` and
 `payload.userAgent` replace the connection's. At most 20 active keys per site.

get.description:
The site's collection keys, newest first, revoked ones included. Never the secret.
 Needs `site.configure`.

post.description:
Revokes one of the site's collection keys at once; requests carrying it are refused.
 Needs `site.configure`. Revoking a revoked key answers the key unchanged.
Deletes one of the caller's saved explorations. Needs `site.read`.

get.description: The caller's saved explorations of the site, newest first. Needs `site.read`.

post.description:
Saves the complete state under a name, or replaces the state and name of one of
 the caller's saved explorations. Saved explorations are personal. Needs `site.read`.

get.description: Custom property keys seen on the site, with their value types. Needs `site.read`.

The most frequent values of one field over the last 30 days. Needs `site.read`. A
 share viewer gets values of granted fields only, inside the share's pinned filter and
 range limit, with `events` 0 unless the share grants the `events` measure.

schema.description: Only values starting with this text, compared case-insensitively.

post.description:
Starts downloading the newest DB-IP Lite City, which replaces the installed one once
 it is verified. Answers at once; `geoip.settings` tells when it is done. Starts
 nothing while a download runs or while `HOLOCRON_GEOIP_DB` names the database.
 Install admins only.

get.description:
The database lookups use now, where it comes from and the download state. Install
 admins only.

post.description:
Archives a goal: it leaves the list, and its versions stay readable for reports
 that reference them. Needs `site.definitions.write`.

get.description:
One version of a goal, archived ones too; the latest without `version`.
 Needs `site.read`.
The site's active goals by name, each at its latest version. Needs `site.read`.

post.description:
Creates a goal at version 1, or with `goal` saves its next version. A save that
 changes only the name renames the goal without a new version. Names are unique
 per site among active goals after case folding. Needs `site.definitions.write`.

get.description:
Click cells and scroll depth of one page and viewport class. Needs
 `site.recordings.read`.

Pages with heatmap interactions in `[start, end)`, most clicked first, at most 100.
 Needs `site.recordings.read`.

post.description:
Creates a link in a workspace. Needs `workspace.write`. The URL must be absolute
 `http` or `https` without credentials.
Deletes a link and erases its hits. Needs `site.delete` and reauthentication.

get.description:
An exploration of a link's hits. The state's `site` is the link. Hits count as
 `events`; the measures are `events`, `visitors` and `visitor_days`, without a report.
 Visitors are counted by UTC day. Needs `site.read`.
The workspace's links by name. Needs `site.read`.

post.description: Renames a link, changes its URL or its slug. Needs `site.configure`.

Removes a member. Any member may remove themselves (R-SELF-LEAVE); removing someone
 else needs `team.manage` and a higher rank. The last owner cannot leave.

Changes a member's role. Needs `team.manage`; the caller must outrank the member and
 the new role must be below the caller's own, except that owners may make owners and
 change other owners' roles (R-RANK). Nobody changes their own role, so a team keeps an
 owner. Raising to admin or owner needs reauthentication (decision 0007).

get.description:
Collection state, readiness problems, disk and recording budgets, the latest
 retention, compaction and backup outcomes, daily storage samples and the forecast
 from the latest one. Install admins only; others get `forbidden`.

post.description: Creates a pixel in a workspace. Needs `workspace.write`.
Deletes a pixel and erases its hits. Needs `site.delete` and reauthentication.

get.description: `links.explore` for a pixel.
The workspace's pixels by name. Needs `site.read`.

post.description: Renames a pixel or changes its slug. Needs `site.configure`.

get.description:
Active visitors, the last 30 minutes and recent events, with the cursor to follow
 changes on `GET /api/subscribe`. Needs `site.read`.

post.description:
Rebuilds sessions and day aggregates of the identity days `first_day` to
 `last_day` under the current session policy. Needs `site.configure`. At most 366
 days per request.

get.description: Whether a recalculation has finished. Needs `site.configure`.

Recording storage of the whole installation against its cap. Needs `site.configure`
 on the named site.

One page of a replay's events in recording order, at most 4 MiB of event JSON. Pass
 `next` as `after` for the following page. Needs `site.recordings.read`. A replay
 outside a viewer's share is `not_found`.

schema.description: The `next` cursor of the previous page.

get.description:
Captured replays received in `[start, end)`, newest first, at most `limit` per page.
 Needs `site.recordings.read`. A share viewer lists only replays inside the share's
 range limit and pinned filter; a page may then hold fewer than `limit` with `next`.
 With `filter`, the session match runs on the report lane with its timeout
 (`query_timeout`); a refused filter answers with the exploration's error codes.

schema.description: Receive time range, Unix milliseconds, `start` inclusive, `end` exclusive.
Only replays that visited a page whose path contains this text.
Only replays from this device class, for example `mobile`.
Only replays of this analytical session.

JSON text of a `Group`: only replays whose analytical session, found as for `session`,
has at least one pageview or custom event matching it. Checked like an exploration's
`filter`, with the same limits (0004); a refused filter lists nothing.
The `next` cursor of the previous page.

get.description: The recording policy of a site. Needs `site.configure`.

post.description:
Keeps a replay past the 14-day removal. Needs `site.recordings.read`. Saved replays
 share a 5 GiB part of the recording cap per installation; a save beyond it is refused
 with `saved_replay_budget_exceeded`. Saving a saved replay changes nothing.
Returns a saved replay to the 14-day removal. Needs `site.recordings.read`.

Changes what the recorder captures on a site. Needs `site.configure`. Recording is off
 until enabled; masking is always strict. Refused with `stale_revision` when
 `expected_revision` is older than the site topic. An unchanged policy records nothing.

get.description:
What `retention.updateDefault` with the same arguments would remove, summed over
 the sources that follow the default. Needs `install.admin`.
The installation default and whether the caller may change it.

post.description:
Changes the installation default. Needs `install.admin`. Shortening needs
 reauthentication and applies to every site, link and pixel without its own setting.
 An unchanged setting records nothing.

get.description:
The requirements the caller may see: the installation's, and each team where the
 caller holds `team.manage` (every team for install admins). User-level requirements
 are in `users.list`.

post.description:
Turns a 2FA requirement on or off. Installation and user scope need `install.admin`,
 team scope needs `team.manage` on the team (a hidden team is `not_found`). Needs
 reauthentication. An unchanged setting records nothing.

get.description: The site's segments by name. Needs `site.read`.

post.description:
Saves a named filter group for everyone who can read the site. Names are unique per
 site after case folding. Needs `site.definitions.write`.

get.description:
One session: its fields, its pageviews and custom events in order (up to 500) and
 the latest value of each identified session property. Needs `site.read`; an unknown
 session is `not_found`.

schema.description: The session ID from the session list report.

get.description:
The latest sessions starting in the last `hours`, with their pageviews and custom
 events by time, for a timeline. Needs `site.read`.

post.description:
Creates a share and discloses its viewer token once. Exploration shares need
 `site.share` on the state's site, board shares `workspace.write` and `site.share` on
 every listed site. `export` needs `site.export`, `recordings` needs
 `site.recordings.read`: a share never grants more than its creator holds. The limits
 must not be wider than the shared state needs. `expires_at` at most 366 days ahead.
 Board shares grant no recordings, and their viewers explore only the board's cards
 with another range or page.

get.description:
Shares of one site (`site`) or one board (`board`), exactly one of the two, newest
 first, revoked and expired ones included. Same capabilities as `sharing.revoke`.

What the caller's share token opens. Without a token, and for unknown, revoked and
 expired tokens, the same `not_found`.

post.description:
Revokes a share at once: viewers get `not_found` and their subscriptions end. Needs
 `site.share` (exploration) or `workspace.write` (board).

Changes the name, actions, lifetime and, for exploration shares, the limits. Same
 capabilities as `sharing.create`. The token stays. A revoked share cannot change.

Creates a site in a workspace. Needs `workspace.write`. Name and domain follow
 `sites.update`; the timezone starts the site's first session policy.

Deletes a site with its analytical data, recordings, definitions, shares and key
 grants, in both engines. Needs `site.delete` (admin and owner, decision 0007) and
 reauthentication.

get.description: One site with the caller's capabilities on it. A hidden site answers like a missing one.
Whether the site links consented visitors to persistent profiles. Needs `site.configure`.

Sites the caller is a member for, by workspace and name. Install admins get every
 site's metadata (name, domain, workspace), with `role` absent where they are not
 members; no analytics (decision 0007).

post.description:
Removes every event, session and recording of a site and keeps its settings,
 definitions and shares. Needs `site.delete` and reauthentication.

get.description: What `sites.updateRetention` with the same arguments would remove. Needs `site.delete`.

schema.description: The site's own setting. Absent follows the installation default.

get.description:
The `<script>` tags that put the pinned tracker, and the recorder when the site
 records, on a page. Needs `site.configure`.

schema.description:
Origin the browser reached the dashboard at, such as `https://stats.example.com`. Used
only when the server has no public URL configured, as upstream falls back to the page's
origin.

post.description:
Moves a site to another workspace. Needs `site.transfer` on the site and
 `workspace.write` on the target team; a hidden target is `not_found`. Moving to a
 user's personal workspace is owner only (R-OWNER-ONLY). Needs reauthentication.
 Shares and key grants of the site end.

Renames a site or changes its domain. Needs `site.configure`. Refused with
 `stale_revision` when `expected_revision` is older than the site topic.

Turns persistent identified analytics on or off and bumps the identity policy
 version. Needs `site.configure`. Turning it off revokes every consent at once
 (0001). An unchanged setting records nothing.

Sets how long the site keeps analytical events, or follows the installation default
 without `retention` (0016). Needs `site.delete`. Shortening needs reauthentication;
 queries hide what lies before the new cutoff at once and the hourly retention job
 removes it. An unchanged setting records nothing.

Changes the timezone or inactivity window as a new session policy version. Needs
 `site.configure`. A timezone change rotates identity at `effective_at` and may not
 take effect in the past; a window change effective in the past recalculates from
 there (0002). An unchanged policy records nothing.

get.description:
The site's current findings in rank order, at most `limit`. Needs `site.read`; an
 unreadable site answers `not_found` like an unknown one.

The summaries of up to 100 sites, in request order. Sites the caller cannot read
 (`site.read`), unknown sites and sites without a summary yet are left out, so the
 answer never tells them apart.

schema.description: 1 to 100 site IDs; repeated ones count once.

post.description: Creates a team with the caller as its only owner.

Deletes a team with its sites, boards, shares and invitations. Owner only (R-OWNER-ONLY)
 and needs reauthentication. Personal workspaces cannot be deleted (`not_found`).

get.description: One team with its members. Needs `workspace.read`.
Pending, used, revoked and expired invitations, newest first. Needs `team.manage`.

post.description:
Creates a single-use invitation for one role and discloses its code once. Needs
 `team.manage`, and the role must be below the caller's own, except that owners may
 invite owners (R-RANK). Lifetime 1 to 30 days, 7 by default.

Redeems an invitation code and adds the caller with its role. Unknown, used, revoked
 and expired codes answer the same `not_found`. Already a member: the role stays and
 the code stays unused.

get.description:
Teams the caller is a member of by name; install admins get every team, with
 `role` absent where they are not members.

post.description: Revokes a pending invitation. Needs `team.manage`.
Renames a team. Needs `team.manage`.

Starts enrollment, or reenrollment while enrolled: creates a pending secret and
 discloses it once. The active factor, if any, keeps working until `twoFactor.confirm`.
 Calling it again replaces the pending secret. Reachable from an enrollment-only session.
 Reenrollment needs reauthentication; a first enrollment does not.

Confirms the pending secret with a current code, makes it the active factor and
 discloses a fresh set of 10 recovery codes once. An enrollment-only session becomes a
 full session. A wrong code is `second_factor_invalid`; no pending secret is
 `invalid_arguments` on `code`. Replacing a confirmed factor needs reauthentication.

Removes the factor and its recovery codes. Needs reauthentication. When a policy
 requires 2FA, the caller's sessions become enrollment-only at their next request.
Replaces every recovery code with 10 new ones, disclosed once. Needs reauthentication.

Creates an account with a generated password, disclosed once for the admin to hand
 over. There is no self sign-up and no default password (R-BOOT). A taken email is
 `invalid_arguments` on `email`.

Erases an account as decision 0007 User erasure scope lists. Needs reauthentication.
 Refused with `user_owns_resources` (naming them in `owned`) while the user is the
 only owner of a workspace or owns personal sites, and with `last_install_admin` for
 the last install admin. Leaves a tombstone of ID and deletion time.

get.description: One account with its workspace memberships.
Every account by email.

post.description:
The recovery path without email: sets a new generated password (disclosed once)
 and/or removes the second factor, and ends the user's sessions. Needs reauthentication.

Changes name, email or installation role. Demoting the last install admin is
 `last_install_admin`.

get.description:
Workspaces the caller is a member of, each with its sites, ordered by name. This is
 the only source of header context options.

message.description: English text for logs and developers. Not shown to people and not stable.

errors.description: Field errors keyed by argument name, for `invalid_arguments`.

ApiErrorBody.description: The body of every non-2xx API answer.

oneOf.description: No valid credential. Sent whether or not the resource exists.
Wrong password or unknown account. Both answer identically.
The password was correct; a second factor is needed next.
The session may only enroll a second factor (decision 0007).
A sensitive command needs a password check within the last 10 minutes.
Missing, hidden and unknown resources and operations all answer with this code and the same body.
The resource is visible but the role lacks the capability.
An API key does not hold this operation.
The request widens a shared exploration.
A mutation without the request marker or from another origin.
`expected_revision` is older than the resource. `current` carries the head.
The idempotency key was used for another operation or other arguments.

`users.delete` while the user is the only owner of a workspace or owns personal sites.
`owned` lists them.
Saving this replay would put saved replays over their 5 GiB part of the recording cap.
The request does not parse: bad JSON, wrong types, missing idempotency key.
Arguments parse but fail validation. `errors` names each field.
Two conditions in one exploration state share a predicate ID.

The comparison cannot be computed for this state: a `typical_weekday` baseline with a
money measure, a percentile, identified people, a report kind other than goals, or a
range over 31 days (decision 0015).
The body or query string exceeds its byte limit.
An analytical query ran past its 30 second budget and was cancelled.

The server is in setup mode: only the setup wizard answers until an admin exists
(decision 0021).
The setup token is missing or wrong. Shares the sign-in limit of 10 a minute.

The setup wizard's import is running, or not finished yet, so it cannot start again, be
discarded or be acknowledged.

limit.description: The limit that was exceeded, for `too_short`, `too_long` and `too_many`.

oneOf.description: More items than the limit allows.

OwnedResource.description: A workspace or site that must be transferred or deleted before its owner can be erased.

WorkspaceId.description: A personal or team workspace that owns sites.

SiteId.description: A tracked website. Matches the `website` ID the Umami tracker sends.

idempotency_key.description:
Repeating a key repeats the same intent: the stored answer comes back without running
the command again. 1 to 128 characters, kept for 24 hours.

revision.description:
Sequence of the last topic event the command recorded, or the installation head when it
recorded none.

Head of the snapshot's topic, read in the same transaction as the data. Pass it as
`expected_revision` to a command that changes the same resource.

api_base.description: Path prefix of the dashboard API, without a trailing slash.

version.description: Server version, shown in the sidebar footer.

instance_name.description: The operator's name for this installation, shown in the shell and the document title.

dbip_attribution.description:
The GeoIP database in use is DB-IP's, whose licence needs a link to db-ip.com on pages
that show location (decision 0018).

setup.description: The server runs in setup mode: only `/setup` and its endpoints answer (decision 0021).

RuntimeConfig.description: Served uncached, so a changed server setting reaches the browser without rebuilding the app.

Empty.description: Arguments of operations that take none.

InstallRole.description:
Installation-wide role. `install_admin` manages the installation and reads no site data
unless it is also a workspace member (decision 0007).

timezone.description: IANA timezone new explorations start in, for example `Europe/Vienna`.

Preferences.description: Per-person display settings. The browser applies them; the server only stores them.

oneOf.description: The last `count` units ending with the current one, in the state's timezone.
Inclusive local dates `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Every retained day through today: from the retention cutoff or the site's first stored
event, whichever is later (0016).

Locale.description: Languages the web app ships catalogs for.

Accent.description: Accent colour presets the web app ships.

main.description: The state's own cut. With a report it has no totals, rows or series.

panels.description: The requested panels, in request order. Empty with a report.

report.description: The output of the state's report, which defines its own output (0004 Report definitions).

retention_start.description:
Set when the range starts before the site's retention cutoff (0016): the first retained
instant.

compare_days.description:
The local dates `YYYY-MM-DD` a `typical_weekday` baseline reads, ascending, after
clipping at the retention cutoff and the site's first stored event. Replaces
`compare_start` and `compare_end` for that comparison.

ResolvedRange.description: The range a result covers, resolved once per request. Unix milliseconds, half-open.

watermark_batch.description:
Last applied batch and the last accepted inbox sequence it contains: every record
acknowledged up to it is visible.

watermark_at.description:
Every record received before this instant is visible: the receive time of the oldest
record the watermark does not reach, or now when it reaches all. Unix milliseconds on
the application clock.

stale.description:
Analytics is over a minute behind collection (readiness problem `analytics_stale`).
Views then show data until `watermark_at` rather than until now.

corrected_through.description: Every batch up to this one has had its dirty identity days corrected.

dirty_days.description: Identity days that can still change the range.

session_policy_versions.description: Session policy versions in effect anywhere in the range, ascending.

imported.description:
Present when the range reaches history imported from Umami. Imported visitors are Umami
session IDs per local day, sessions are recomputed from event times, and imported events
never count toward identified people or retention (decision 0013).

oneOf.description: Derived rows are final for the current ingestion watermark.
Dirty identity days can still change the result; it must say so.

ImportedHistory.description: The imported snapshot a result reaches and the event times it spans, Unix milliseconds.

VisitorLabel.description: "visitors" when the range lies inside one identity day, else "visitor_days" (0003).

totals.description: One value per measure over every matching row; paging does not change it.

projection.description:
Where each total ends when the range ends after now: one entry per measure, `null` for a
measure that is not a count.

rows.description: The requested page of rows. Empty without dimensions.

Cut.description: The totals, rows and series of one cut, all from the same snapshot.

Panel.description: Another cut of the same rows and range: its own measures, dimensions, sort and page.

Measure.description: A measure: a named formula of decision 0003 or a statistic over one numeric property.

oneOf.description: Distinct daily pseudonyms; labelled "visitors" only inside one identity day.
Revenue per currency in minor units: all records, positive ones, negative ones.
Revenue records with a non-zero amount.
Nearest-rank percentiles of one performance metric; need a `perf_metric` condition.

Field.description: A dimension or a typed custom property.

oneOf.description: The performance metric of a performance event: `lcp`, `fcp`, `ttfb`, `inp` or `cls`.
ISO 4217 currency of a revenue record.
ISO weekday 1 (Monday) to 7, wall clock in the state's timezone.
0 to 23, wall clock in the state's timezone.

DimensionField.description:
Built-in fields. Event fields come from the event; session fields from the event's session
(0004 Field scope).

oneOf.description: Rounded half to even to 4 places, with the exact parts it came from.
Integer milliseconds.
Decimal string with 4 places.
Revenue per currency, by currency code; never summed across currencies (0003 Revenue).

exponent.description: Minor-unit digits of the currency: 2 for EUR, 0 for JPY.

minor_units.description:
Integer minor units: a JSON number up to 2^53 − 1 in magnitude, else a decimal string
(0004 Encoding conventions).

amount.description: The amount as a decimal string with `exponent` fractional digits: `"49.91"`, `"4500"`.

Money.description: An exact amount of one currency (0002 Currencies and revenue).

oneOf.description: A rate whose denominator is 0.
A statistic over no numeric rows.
Relative change against a previous value of 0.
A percentile over observations of several performance metrics, whose units differ.
Fewer than 4 baseline days for a typical-weekday baseline or projection (0015).

change.description: `current − previous`; absent when either side is unavailable.

Comparison.description:
The previous period's or the typical weekday's value and the change to it (0003 Comparison
and zero baselines).

oneOf.description: The median projection over the basis days, with its 25th to 75th percentile band.

Projection.description:
A labelled estimate of where a count measure ends (0015 Pace projection). Never a measured
value: it stays out of `totals`, `rows` and `points`.

key.description: One cell per dimension, in dimension order.

values.description: One value per measure, in measure order.

oneOf.description: RFC 3339 instant.

Cell.description: A result cell key: a typed value, a present JSON `null`, or no value.

series_sum_differs.description: The visitor series adds up to more than the headline, which counts each pseudonym once.

projection.description: Projected buckets from now to the end of the range, kept apart from `points`.

local.description: Bucket start as local wall time `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` in the state's timezone.

compare.description:
One comparison per measure when compared: previous-period buckets align by offset,
typical-weekday buckets by local weekday and wall-clock hour.

local.description: Bucket start as local wall time `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` in the state's timezone.

values.description: One entry per measure; `null` for a measure that is not a count.

Coverage.description: Eligible events with a daily pseudonym or profile, out of all eligible events (0003).

ReportResult.description: The output of one report kind, shaped after decision 0003.

drop.description: `reached` minus the next step's; absent for the last step.

exited.description: No further page in the session: they left.

back.description: Next page was one the session had already shown.

next.description: The three most common other next pages, most identities first.

other.description: The rest: other next pages, and step events without a session.

sessions.description: The latest sessions that dropped here, newest first, at most 20.

FunnelLeak.description:
The identities that reached a step but not the next, by the page their session showed
next within the funnel's read span (0003 Funnels).

steps.description: One per step, in step order.

conversion.description: Identities reaching the last step out of those entering step 1.

daily_limit.description: Daily scope: the pseudonym changes at local midnight, so no identity progresses across it.

coverage.description: Daily identity coverage, or consented coverage for person scope.

leaks.description: Where the identities dropping after each step went: one per step but the last.

sequences.description: The top 100 by sessions, then by sequence element by element, a prefix first.

secret.description: The generated password when `password` was set. `null` otherwise and in a replay.

apiKey.description: A scoped API key. Reaches only the operations and sites in its grants.

share.description: `Authorization: Share <token>`. Reaches only the share's operations, sites and limits.
